profile.name: NI数字输入数据采集设备
profile.description: 用于采集数字电平和开关量信号的NI数据采集设备或模块，常见于PCIe、USB或cDAQ系统。适合在实验中读取TTL状态、触发信号、联锁状态以及其他数字输入信号。
profile.description_en: An NI data acquisition device or module used to acquire digital level and on/off signals, commonly found in PCIe, USB, or cDAQ systems. It is used in laboratories to read TTL states, trigger lines, interlock signals, and other digital input signals.

registry.name: National Instruments Analog Input Task
registry.description: Digital Input Task是由National Instruments生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括写入数据、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, max convert rate等操作。
